There is still a chance to cherry-pick the fix into 0.13.0

Yes, I think in that case this should be a release blocker for 0.13.0. According to @ulfjack the issue is not specific to remote execution, but after his patch Bazel simply requires gcov to be installed on the system. Remote Execution just happens to trigger this bug.
